title: Chromatic Number, Greedy Bounds and Brooks' Theorem
quickIdea: The chromatic number is the fewest colours in a proper colouring; a clique gives only a lower bound and greedy gives an upper bound that depends on the order vertices are taken.
remember: chi(G) is the least k such that V splits into k independent colour classes, and chi = 1 exactly when G has no edge.
chi = 2 exactly for bipartite graphs with at least one edge, so chi is at least 3 exactly when G has an odd cycle.
chi(K_n) = n, chi(C_n) = 2 for even n and 3 for odd n, and every tree with at least one edge has chi = 2.
The clique number omega and the maximum degree Delta bracket the answer: omega is at most chi, and chi is at most Delta + 1 by greedy colouring.
Brooks sharpens the upper bound to chi at most Delta unless G is complete or an odd cycle, where chi = Delta + 1.

chi is at least n / alpha, since with k colour classes one class holds at least n/k vertices, and a k-chromatic graph has at least k(k-1)/2 edges because every two colour classes must be joined by an edge.
A k-chromatic graph need not contain K_k: C_5 and the Petersen graph both have omega = 2 and chi = 3, and deciding chi is NP-hard.

example.prompt: For the Petersen graph give chi, omega and alpha.
example.work: Petersen has 10 vertices and is 3-regular, and it contains 5-cycles, so chi is at least 3; a 3-colouring exists, so chi = 3. It has no triangle, so omega = 2. Its largest independent set has 4 vertices, so alpha = 4, and indeed chi is at least 10/4.

gateAngle: Three verified patterns: the formula n - 2 floor(n/2) + 2 for cycles (GATE CSE 2002 Q.1.4), the counting bounds on a k-chromatic graph (GATE CSE 2024 Set 1 Q.41), and the Petersen graph's chi = 3 with alpha = 4 (GATE CSE 2022 Q.40).

variations.label: ORIGINAL PYQ-STYLE QUESTION
variations.question: A graph has 20 vertices and chromatic number 4. What is the least possible number of edges?
variations.answer: 6, which is C(4,2), reached by K_4 together with 16 isolated vertices.
variations.why: Each pair of the 4 colour classes needs an edge between them, and K_4 realises exactly one edge per pair.

variations.label: CONCEPTUAL PRACTICE QUESTION
variations.question: Does chi(G) = 3 force G to contain a triangle?
variations.answer: No. C_5 and the Petersen graph are triangle-free with chromatic number 3.
variations.why: Odd cycles and odd-cycle-rich graphs raise the chromatic number without creating cliques, so omega is only a lower bound.

variations.label: PREDICTED VARIATION
variations.question: A graph has maximum degree 4 and is neither complete nor an odd cycle. What is the largest possible chromatic number?
variations.why: Greedy already gives 5, and Brooks removes one colour except in the two excluded families.

trap.what: Equating chi with the clique number omega, and forgetting that a graph with no edges has chromatic number 1.
trap.why: omega is only a lower bound: C_5 has omega = 2 and chi = 3. At the other end, 100 isolated vertices need one colour, not zero.
trap.counterexample: C_5 has omega = 2 and chi = 3; the Petersen graph has omega = 2 and chi = 3; a graph of 100 isolated vertices has chi = 1.

check.question: A graph has 12 vertices and chromatic number 4. What is the guaranteed size of an independent set?
check.explanation: Four colour classes partition 12 vertices, so by the pigeonhole principle one class holds at least 3 vertices, and a colour class is an independent set. This is the second statement of GATE CSE 2024 Set 1 Q.41.

sourceLine: Chromatic number, the standard families, the independent-set and edge-count bounds: GATE Overflow GO Classroom deck (English, read in part) for the colouring and independent-set statements; Brooks and Dirac from West. Standard references used to verify, never copied: Rosen, Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications, ch. 10; West, Introduction to Graph Theory (Brooks, Dirac, Koenig, chromatic polynomial); CLRS ch. 22 (articulation points, bridges) and ch. 26 (bipartite matching); Diestel, Graph Theory (Menger). Every chromatic number, clique number, independence number and bound in this card is recomputed in scripts/validate.py.
